content:
```sql
SELECT *
FROM Resposts
WHERE Ratings = 5
  AND IsNearBeach = 1
ORDER BY Ratings DESC;
```

This query will:
- Filter for hotels with 5-star ratings (`Ratings = 5`)
- Filter for hotels near the beach (`IsNearBeach = 1`, assuming 1 = true)
- Order results by rating (though they'll all be 5 stars in this case)
- Return all columns so the user can see full details of each recommended hotel
